messages:
maria_product: @ben flagged a compliance packet from HealthOne.
ben_sales: They want SOC2 + HIPAA, signed BAA, exportable raw audit logs for 7 years, and the right to review on-prem. PDF attached. :grimacing:
maria_product: Can product/security do quick triage? Need to know if this is roadmap priority or negotiation.
katie_security: Quick take: 7 yrs is above our current default (1 yr). We have SOC2 Type II report we can share. On-prem review is doable but needs legal + SRE supervision. Also need to scope PHI handling under HIPAA.
priya_legal: Recommend negotiating retention down to 2 yrs, provide signed BAA, and offer assisted on-site review with limited scope. Avoid unlimited access to raw PII. Also add cost-recovery clause for extended retention/on-site work.
omar_eng: Engineering estimate for export-based solution (S3 + lifecycle rules + access logs): ~3 wks to ship a configurable export pipeline + 1 sprint for RBAC + 1 sprint for tests. Native in-platform 7yr storage adds infra + cost ops, likely 6-8 wks.
alex_support: Ops notes: we'll need per-customer retention config, UI flag, and a way to filter PII from logs (masking) before retention. Also retention_days must be configurable per-route.
nora_custsuccess: HealthOne is strategic (possible $500k ARR). Sales wants a fast path—if we can deliver an export + BAA in 2 weeks they'll sign a term sheet.
maria_product: Proposal: immediate deliverable = share SOC2 + signed BAA + S3 export template + one-off export setup as professional services. Roadmap: retention-as-a-paid-feature (self-service per-customer retention_days + masking + audit export). Launch criteria needed.
ben_sales: Agreed. Sales will accept export + BAA in 2 weeks if legal signs off.
priya_legal: Can do BAA draft within 3 business days; need statement of work for on-site assistance.
omar_eng: For roadmap feature, suggested acceptance criteria:

```
- retention_days configurable per-customer (default 365)
- S3 export reachable via presigned URL and IAM role
- encryption at rest + in-transit
- masking pipeline for PII (configurable)
- infra cost estimate and alerting
- e2e tests + load test for long-tail cache behavior
```

maria_product: rollout plan: beta opt-in -> 2 customers -> monitor cost/latency -> GA after 6 weeks. Billing: per-GB-month plus admin fee.
compliance-bot: evidence: soc2-report-2024.pdf available at https://artifacts/redwood/soc2-2024 (access: redwood/sales)
alex_support: Action items:
- @priya_legal: BAA draft (3 business days)
- @omar_eng: kick off export pipeline spike and cost estimate (EOD Wed)
- @katie_security: HIPAA handling checklist + masking spec (EOD Thu)
- @maria_product: prepare customer-facing proposal + SOW (tomorrow)
- @ben_sales: hold signal with HealthOne until we confirm timeline (:eyes:)

maria_product: tagging this for prioritization meeting tomorrow. If HealthOne signs, we escalate to P1 for next sprint.
